c: Consequential luck
luck in the way our actions and projects turn out
Circumstantial luck
luck in the situations and moral tests life puts in front of us
Causal luck
luck in the events that happen just before an action and decide whether it is completed
Constitutive luck
luck in the kind of person we are: our genes, upbringing and character

q.s: Two surgeons make exactly the same small mistake during an operation. One patient recovers by chance; the other dies. Only the second surgeon is sued and loses his reputation.
q.why: İki cerrah aynı hatayı yaptı; tek fark eylemin nasıl sonuçlandığı. Metne göre 'the way one's actions and projects turn out' sonuç şansıdır (consequential).

q.s: An elderly man is praised by everyone for his honesty. However, in his long career as a clerk, nobody ever offered him a bribe or put him under pressure to lie.
q.why: Adam hiç ahlaki bir sınavla karşılaşmadı; dürüstlüğü hiç sınanmadı. Bu, hayatın önümüze koyduğu durumlarla ilgili durumsal şanstır (circumstantial).

q.s: A man fires a gun at his neighbour, but at that very moment the neighbour bends down to tie his shoe and the bullet misses. The man is charged only with attempted murder.
q.why: Eylemin tamamlanıp tamamlanmadığını, hemen öncesinde olan bir olay (eğilmek) belirledi. Metindeki 'the victim unexpectedly tripped' örneğinin aynısı: nedensel şans (causal).

q.s: A woman has a naturally hot temper, which she inherited from her father and which was strengthened by a difficult childhood. Her colleagues criticise her for shouting in meetings.
q.why: Eleştirilen şey kişinin karakteri; bu karakteri genler ve yetiştirilme belirledi. Metne göre bu 'the kind of person an individual is' ile ilgili yapısal şanstır (constitutive).

q.s: Two climbers ignore a storm warning. One returns safely; the other is caught in an avalanche and has to be rescued by a team that risks their lives. Only the second climber is called irresponsible in the newspapers.
q.why: İkisi aynı riski aldı, ama yalnızca sonucu kötü olan suçlanıyor. Eleştiri sonuca göre değişiyor: consequential luck.

c: Purpose of punishment
punishment should deter; a risky act should be punished whether or not harm follows
Proximate causation
when the chain between the act and the harm is unusual, it is hard to say who caused the result, so intentions should decide
Moral superiority
judging by outcomes is a less developed, instinctive form of moral reasoning than judging by intentions
Need for frugality
punishment should be used economically; failed attempts can be punished more lightly without losing deterrence

q.s: A man pushes his neighbour during an argument. The neighbour is not hurt, but while running away he is hit by a car and dies. The court cannot agree whether the man actually caused the death.
q.why: Eylem ile ölüm arasındaki nedensellik zinciri olağandışı; sonucu kimin getirdiği belirsiz. Bu, metindeki bıçaklı saldırı ve araba kazası örneğine denk gelen proximate causation argümanı.

q.s: Lawmakers propose that drivers who speed through a school zone should receive the same heavy fine whether or not they hit anyone, so that careless drivers stop taking such risks.
q.why: Amaç caydırmak ve dikkatsiz risk yaratanları önlemek; sonuç önemli değil. Metne göre bu argüman özellikle 'negligent creators of risk' için geçerli: purpose of punishment.

q.s: A psychologist observes that five-year-olds think a child who accidentally broke fifteen cups is naughtier than a child who broke one cup while stealing biscuits.
q.why: Küçük çocuklar sonuca (kırılan bardak sayısına) göre yargılıyor. Metne göre sonuca dayalı yargılar ahlaki gelişimin erken evresine özgüdür: moral superiority.

q.s: A judge gives a lighter sentence to a burglar who failed to break into a house, arguing that a heavier sentence would not have stopped a criminal who was already determined to commit the crime.
q.why: Kararlı suçlu ağır cezadan zaten caymaz; bu yüzden başarısız girişime hafif ceza vermek caydırıcılıktan bir şey kaybettirmez. Bu, nesnelcilerin 'need for frugality' argümanı.

c: Casual crowd
people in the same place who are not really interacting
Conventional crowd
people who come together for a scheduled event and behave as expected
Expressive crowd
people who gather to express emotion together
Acting crowd
people who focus on a goal or action, such as a protest or riot; spontaneous and unorganised
Mass
a large, scattered group with a common interest whose members do not know each other and cannot act together
Public
a scattered group that faces an issue, is divided about it and discusses it

q.s: After the winning goal in a cup final, thousands of fans in the stadium sing, cry and hug strangers around them.
q.why: İnsanlar duygularını birlikte ifade ediyor (şarkı, ağlama, sarılma). Metindeki 'join together to express emotion' tanımı: expressive crowd.

q.s: Passengers stand silently on a platform, each looking at their own phone while waiting for a delayed train.
q.why: Aynı yerdeler ama birbirleriyle etkileşmiyorlar; metindeki otobüs kuyruğu örneği gibi: casual crowd.

q.s: Angry residents suddenly block a road with their cars to force the council to repair a dangerous bridge.
q.why: Belli bir amaca odaklanan, kendiliğinden ve örgütsüz bir eylem (protesto). Metne göre bu acting crowd.

q.s: An audience quietly watches a scheduled opera performance and applauds at the end.
q.why: Planlanmış bir etkinlik için toplanmış, beklenen biçimde davranan insanlar: conventional crowd.

q.s: Millions of people across the country follow a celebrity's trial every evening on television, but they never meet or contact each other.
q.why: Ortak ilgi var ama üyeler birbirini tanımıyor ve birlikte hareket edemiyor. Metinde TV izleyicileri örneği verilir: mass.

q.s: Citizens who disagree about plans for a new airport argue about it in online forums, newspapers and town meetings.
q.why: Bir sorunla karşı karşıyalar, nasıl çözüleceği konusunda bölünmüşler ve tartışıyorlar. Blumer'ın tanımına göre bu public; kitleden farkı fikir alışverişi.

c: Learned helplessness
the expectation that events are independent of one's responses, so trying seems useless
Mastery orientation
after failure, focusing on finding a solution rather than on the causes of failure
Attribution retraining
teaching people to explain failure by lack of effort rather than lack of ability
Hopelessness theory
depression follows when a negative cognitive style meets a stressful life event

q.s: After failing three maths exams, Deniz stops studying completely. 'Whatever I do, the result will be the same,' he says.
q.why: Deniz eylemleriyle sonuç arasında bağ olmadığına inanıyor ve çabalamayı bırakıyor. Metindeki tanım: 'events are independent of one's responses'.

q.s: Selin fails a chemistry quiz. Instead of thinking about why it happened, she immediately tries a new way of revising and asks her teacher for extra exercises.
q.why: Başarısızlığın nedenleri yerine çözüme odaklanıyor. Diener ve Dweck'e göre bu 'mastery-oriented' çocukların özelliği.

q.s: A school counsellor teaches a group of struggling pupils to say 'I didn't try hard enough' instead of 'I'm not clever enough'. Their reactions to failure improve dramatically.
q.why: Başarısızlığı yetenek yerine çabaya bağlamayı öğretmek, Dweck'in 1978 çalışmasındaki eğitimdir; metinde bu çocukların 'striking improvement' gösterdiği yazıyor.

q.s: Emre has always tended to see bad events as his own fault and as permanent. When he loses his job, he becomes seriously depressed.
q.why: Olumsuz bilişsel stil + stresli bir olay birlikte depresyona yol açıyor. Bu, Abramson, Metalsky ve Alloy'un hopelessness theory açıklaması.

c: Referential content
the plot: what clearly happens in the story, which all viewers would agree on
Explicit content
the message or point that the film states openly
Implicit content
less obvious meanings that viewers have to interpret, which may differ from viewer to viewer
Symptomatic content
what the film reveals about the society, values or ideology of the time that produced it

q.s: 'The film is about a boy who loses his dog and searches the whole city for it until he finds it at the train station.'
q.why: Yalnızca olay örgüsü anlatılıyor; filmi izleyen herkes buna katılır. Metne göre bu referential content (temel hikâye).

q.s: At the end of the film, the grandfather tells the family, 'Money comes and goes, but we have each other.' A reviewer writes that this is the film's lesson.
q.why: Mesaj filmde açıkça söyleniyor. Açıkça dile getirilen anlam explicit content.

q.s: A critic notices that the heroine is often filmed behind windows and locked doors, and argues that these images suggest her loneliness.
q.why: Anlam açıkça söylenmiyor; izleyici imgelerden yorumluyor ve farklı izleyiciler farklı yorumlayabilir. Bu implicit content.

q.s: A historian argues that the many alien-invasion films made in 1950s America reflect the country's fear of communism at that time.
q.why: Film, üretildiği dönemin toplumu ve korkuları hakkında bir şey ortaya koyuyor. Bu symptomatic content.

c: Structural strain
political, economic or social problems that make people dissatisfied enough to protest
Relative deprivation
feeling deprived compared with another group or an ideal, which matters more than actual deprivation
Social movement
beliefs and actions aimed at bringing about or resisting change in society
Counter movement
beliefs and actions organised against a social movement

q.s: Factory workers whose wages rose steadily for ten years become furious when the raises suddenly stop, although they still earn more than most people in their town.
q.why: Gerçek durumları kötü değil; ama iyileşme durunca kendilerini yoksun hissediyorlar. Davies'e göre koşullar iyileşip durunca hayal kırıklığı ve protesto artar: relative deprivation.

q.s: Hunters and gun shops form an association to campaign against a growing movement that wants to ban hunting.
q.why: Bir toplumsal harekete karşı örgütlenen grup counter movement; metindeki hayvan deneyleri örneğinde bilim insanlarının tepkisi gibi.

q.s: Years of rising unemployment, high prices and limits on political freedom leave many citizens deeply dissatisfied with the government.
q.why: Protestonun zeminini hazırlayan ekonomik ve siyasi sorunlar. Metin bunlara structural strain diyor.
